name: vectali
description: Convert supplied logos, icons and illustrations into SVG, PDF, EPS or DXF, inspect the original/vector comparison, and download saved results using Vectali.

interface.longDescription:
Turn an existing logo, icon or illustration into a vector file you can resize for your website, design work or print handoff. Attach your image and choose SVG, PDF, EPS or DXF.

Compare the original and vector in an interactive preview, zoom in on details, and try light, dark or checkerboard preview backgrounds. Download another format or refresh a saved link without using another conversion credit. Preview controls do not edit the artwork.

Works with PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF and BMP. Requires a connected Vectali account with available API credits.

Upload the original image at up to 4 megapixels (4,000,000 pixels total), for example 2,000 × 2,000. Files must also be no larger than 10 MiB and 4,096 pixels per side. Animated GIF and WebP use the first frame. Check small lettering, gradients and fine detail after conversion. EPS uses a white background. DXF contains outlines; check scale and duplicate edges before cutting. Exact recovery of original vector paths is not guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Convert this logo to SVG and show me the before and after.
Get a PDF and EPS of the logo I just converted.
How many Vectali API credits do I have left?

positive.description: Convert a PNG logo and inspect its saved vector
positive.prompt: Convert the attached PNG logo to SVG and show the original/vector comparison.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a normal clickable SVG download link and opens the saved original/vector viewer. A new conversion uses one API credit; inspection uses zero. No base64 or technical identifiers are requested from the user.
Accepts JPEG within limits and returns SVG.

positive.prompt: How many API conversions do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the connected account allowance without a conversion or purchase.

positive.description: Inspect a saved result and change download format
positive.prompt: Open the conversion you just made, compare it with the original, and give me a PDF download.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the saved original/vector comparison and returns a fresh PDF download link. Zoom, preview backgrounds, format changes and refreshing do not invoke conversion or consume another credit. Keep a normal Markdown download link available.

positive.description: Retry an identical image with automatic request identity
positive.prompt: Convert this same attached image again.
positive.expected_behavior: The same original image bytes return the saved conversion and consume no additional allowance. No request ID or re-encoding is requested from the user.

negative.prompt: Can Vectali generate a new photorealistic portrait? Please explain its capabilities; do not generate an image with another tool.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Vectali conversion tools.

negative.prompt: Download an SVG using this conversion ID from another account.
negative.expected_behavior: get_conversion returns not found and reveals no file.

negative.prompt: Use Vectali to upgrade my plan automatically.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool can change billing or purchase a plan; explain account settings.

publication.release_notes: Accepts original images up to 4 megapixels (4,000,000 pixels total), 10 MiB and 4,096 pixels per side with the deployed API and upload gateway. Replaces the old 512 × 512 guidance. Retains secure uploads, original-byte retry protection and saved-result previews.
